signIn.title: Welcome back
signIn.subtitle: Sign in to access your vault.

signUp.title: Create your account
signUp.subtitle: Join Tokyo Lucky Card and start collecting authenticated cards.
signUp.pdpaLabel: I consent to Tokyo Lucky Card collecting, using, and processing my personal data in accordance with the Thai Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA) and the Privacy Policy.
signUp.pdpaRequired: You must accept the PDPA consent to continue.

callback.error: Google sign-in failed. Please try again.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.passwordMin: Password must be at least 10 characters.
errors.passwordMax: Password must be at most 100 characters.
errors.passwordLetter: Password must contain at least one letter.
errors.passwordDigit: Password must contain at least one number.
errors.passwordIsEmail: Password must not be your email address.
errors.fullNameMax: Name must be at most 80 characters.
errors.fullNameUrl: Name must not contain a web address.
errors.fullNameControl: Name contains characters that are not allowed.

pending.title: Check your inbox
pending.body: We sent you a link to confirm your email address. Top-ups, pulls, buybacks and delivery stay locked until you do.

verified.title: Email confirmed
verified.body: Your account is fully unlocked. Happy collecting.

invalid.title: This link has expired
invalid.body: Verification links are valid for 24 hours. Ask for a new one and we will send it straight away.

forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.subtitle: Enter the email on your account and we will send you a link to set a new password.
forgotPassword.sentBody: If that address has an account, a reset link is on its way. The link is valid for 1 hour.

resetPassword.title: Set a new password
resetPassword.subtitle: Choose a password you have not used anywhere else.
resetPassword.invalidToken: This reset link has expired. Request a new one.
resetPassword.missingTokenBody: It may have been cut short by your email app. Request a new one and open it directly.
resetPassword.doneBody: Everywhere you were signed in has been signed out, including anyone else who had access. Sign in with your new password.

banner.title: Confirm your email to unlock your wallet
banner.body: Top-ups, pulls, buybacks and delivery are locked until you do.
